messages.subject: Re: path diagram to visualize model$results
parts:
Thanks for your question! Unfortunately Genomic SEM is not currently compatible with functions like semPLOT (but it is on our to-do list for future versions). The figures we show on the github were all made in either powerpoint or LaTex. 

-Andrew
